summary: Frontend testing of the new 'الوحدات' (modules) metric-cards tab on ManagementDashboard. Admin: 3 tabs render, all 18 cards visible, core values match academic KPIs exactly (courses=12, students=91, teachers=15, departments=4), the other 14 cards show '—' with Arabic subtitles, all 18 cards route correctly (faculties goes to /general-settings for admin). Switching tabs makes no extra /dashboard/management calls (only HR tab calls /dashboard/management/hr as before). Saeed: 8 cards filtered by permission, values match KPIs (3/72/3), no hr-employees card because Saeed has no HR perms anymore (checked via /auth/me; test_credentials.md is out of date). Academic and HR tabs show no regression. MAIN ISSUE: test_registrar cannot reach the modules tab at all. /dashboard/management returns 403 for the registrar role, so ManagementDashboard shows the full-screen dash-error and never renders the tabs. When that API response was mocked to 200, the registrar's filtering was correct: courses, students, enrollments, manage-attendance, letters, reports and activity-logs showed, and trash, lecture-swaps and student-excuses stayed hidden. The empty state, checked by mocking permissions to [], renders correctly.

ui_bugs.issue: The modules grid can only be reached after /dashboard/management succeeds. Users with no dashboard_* section permissions (e.g. test_registrar, role=registrar) get a 403 'ليس لديك صلاحية عرض أي قسم في لوحة القيادة'. The early return `if (error && !data)` then shows the full-screen dash-error, so these users never see the tabs or the modules grid, even though the grid needs only client-side permissions. These are exactly the limited users the permission-filtered grid is meant for.

issues: Cards are width:'23%' with gap 14, so 4 cards don't fill the row. There is a visible ~55px empty strip on the left of the grid, and the grid doesn't line up with the header/tabs container. Use flex:1 with a basis, or calc widths that account for the gap.
Cards are 23% wide with minWidth 190, so they render at about half the screen width, right-aligned with empty space on the left. Use full width or 2 columns on compact screens.
The period selector (اليوم/الأسبوع/الشهر) still shows on the modules tab where it has no effect, and changing it refetches /dashboard/management. Consider hiding it when view==='modules'.

action_items: HIGH: Let users without dashboard section permissions still reach the modules tab. Options: on a 403 from /dashboard/management, render the tabs plus DashModulesGrid with numbers undefined (cards show '—', or 0 for core keys) instead of the full-screen error, or default view='modules' for such users.
Note: when numbers is undefined, the core cards show '—'. If numbers exists but a key is missing, they show 0 (`numbers[key] ?? 0`). Make this consistent.
Fix the grid width/alignment on desktop and mobile (23% width + minWidth 190).
Optional: hide the period selector on the modules tab.
Update /app/memory/test_credentials.md: Saeed currently has NO hr_* permissions (custom_permissions=[]), so the HR tab and the hr-employees card don't show for him.
critical_code_review_comments: ManagementDashboard.tsx: the early-return error branch hides the whole dashboard, including the permission-only modules tab. This is the root cause of the registrar issue.
DashModulesGrid: the departments card needs manage/view_departments. department_head (Saeed) lacks them, so his card is hidden even though numbers.departments=1 is returned. This may be intended.
DashModulesGrid: the faculties card for non-admins has an empty route, and the card does nothing when tapped. There is no visual cue that it isn't clickable.
Permission filtering mirrors SideMenu and keeps the RBAC fix intact (trash/swaps/excuses stay hidden for registrar).
seed_data_creation: None. Playwright route mocking was used only inside the browser (mocked /dashboard/management 200 for test_registrar, mocked permissions [] for the empty state). No data was changed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login form has no testIDs: use input:not([type=password]), input[type=password], get_by_text('تسجيل الدخول').last. The registrar's 403 on /dashboard/management is the key issue to retest. Expected registrar cards: courses, students, enrollments, manage-attendance, letters, reports, activity-logs. Expected Saeed cards: courses, students, teachers, enrollments, manage-attendance, letters, reports, activity-logs.
rca of the issue: test_registrar's role lacks the dashboard_* section permissions, so the backend returns 403 'ليس لديك صلاحية عرض أي قسم في لوحة القيادة'. In ManagementDashboard, `if (error && !data) return <dash-error/>` runs before the tabs render, so DashViewTabs and DashModulesGrid never mount. Reproduce: log in as test_registrar/test1234 and the home screen shows only the error and retry button. Fix: render the tabs and the modules grid in the 403/no-data case.
